name: 2dtag
description: A 2D multiplayer tag game with hosted lobbies, join codes, 16 maps (guns, invisibility, hide-and-seek, 5x speed, candy freeze, a low-gravity moon map, a flipped-gravity double-coin map, a map with random mini-superpower orbs, a musical-chairs elimination map, and a map where getting tagged turns you into Frankenstein's monster among them), skins, trails, quests, 20 music tracks and bots.
